entities.name: Teutonic Order & German Baltic Nobility
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Livonian branch of the Teutonic Order ruled Estonia. German-speaking nobility (Baltendeutsche) controlled land and politics. Estonian peasant serfdom deepened. The construction of castles at Rakvere, Haapsalu, and Kuressaare.
